checks.name: build
checks.run: t=$(grep -E '^TAG = ' setup-deps.py); if [ ! -d libs/mac ] || [ "$(cat libs/.land-deps 2>/dev/null)" != "$t" ]; then python3 setup-deps.py && echo "$t" > libs/.land-deps || exit 1; fi; mkdir -p build/land && cd build/land && qmake6 ../../moonlight-qt.pro CONFIG+=release >/dev/null && make -j$(sysctl -n hw.perflevel0.physicalcpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4) -s

checks.name: clipboard-unit
checks.run: mkdir -p build/tests-clipboard && cd build/tests-clipboard && qmake6 ../../tests/clipboardsync CONFIG+=sdk_no_version_check >/dev/null && make -s && ./tst_clipboardsync

checks.name: automouse-unit
checks.run: mkdir -p build/tests-automouse && cd build/tests-automouse && qmake6 ../../tests/automouse CONFIG+=sdk_no_version_check >/dev/null && make -s && ./tst_automouse
